recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. issue_request: FHIR-21222 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that StructureDefinition-ext-context resolved to the StructureDefinition.context backbone element rather than the expression value, and accepted a redesign as a composite search parameter over SD.context with separate component parameters for the coded type and context expression.
initial_application: No git commit in this checkout mentions FHIR-21222 directly. The active search-parameter bundle was introduced in 2021 with the older token-over-StructureDefinition.context shape, then git commit 84a650b04be0fcabffb180bb88c24ef8211da93f changed ext-context to composite and added ext-context-type and ext-context-expression definitions. Although that commit was titled for FHIR-27532, the ext-context patch exactly matches FHIR-21222's accepted resolution.
additional_context: StructureDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and StructureDefinition.context remains a BackboneElement with type and expression children. Current R5 publication confirms the later composite/token split.
